scenes.prompt: Cinematic close-up of a developer keyboard glowing with custom RGB lighting in a dark room. The screen displays the logo and interface of Neovim (Modal Terminal Text Editor). Soft cyan neon accent lights, 4k ultra-detailed developer workstation.
scenes.voiceover_text: Should you upgrade to Neovim in 2026? Here is everything you need to know about this Modal Terminal Text Editor in under 60 seconds!

scenes.title: Core Features & Pros
scenes.prompt: Direct macro shot of crisp code editor text being typed at super-fast speed in Neovim. Neon syntax highlighting, multi-file side-by-side view, smooth modern developer desktop UI.
scenes.voiceover_text: Hyperextensible Vim-based text editor built for extreme speed, keyboard-driven navigation, Lua plugin ecosystem, and embedded LSP support. Key benefits include: Blazing fast performance and near-zero memory footprint, Unlimited customizability via Lua and modern plugin managers, Pure keyboard efficiency without mouse reliance, Native Language Server Protocol (LSP) and Treesitter support.

scenes.title: Cons & Trade-offs
scenes.prompt: Split screen technical visualization showing memory usage graphs and code execution comparison in a modern dark-mode software interface.
scenes.voiceover_text: However, keep in mind these trade-offs: Steep learning curve for Vim keybindings, Requires time and effort to configure a full IDE workflow, Lacks built-in visual UI buttons out of the box.
